name: Finding A Spouse
overview: Scripture reveals that God created marriage as a divine provision for companionship, declaring it is not good for man to be alone and providing a suitable helper for him (Genesis 2:18). The union of husband and wife is designed to be a lasting, intimate bond where two become one flesh (Genesis 2:24). Finding a spouse is presented as a blessing from the Lord, with a virtuous and prudent wife described as a crown and a gift that brings favor and stability (Proverbs 12:4; 18:22; 19:14). Ultimately, delighting in the Lord aligns the desires of the heart, including the longing for a godly spouse (Psalms 37:4).
